22.description: Saskatoon approved a sponsorship request for the Pollinator Paradise YXE project by Wild About Saskatoon.

chips.text: Wild About Saskatoon received sponsorship approval for their project.
The project aims to create a pollinator paradise in Saskatoon.

20.description: The committee recommends City Council fund a $168,800 over-expenditure for 2025 elm wood disposal, which saw double the volume due to waived landfill fees. This funding would come from existing reserves.

chips.text: Residents and businesses benefited from waived elm wood disposal fees.
Initiative aims to slow the spread of Dutch Elm Disease.

21.description: The committee recommends establishing a Community Energy Loan Program (CELP) to help commercial and multi-unit residential buildings fund energy upgrades, aiming for a 20% energy reduction. It would prioritize small businesses, non-profits, and affordable housing.

chips.text: The environmental impact of AI software used for virtual energy audits has not been assessed.
Program prioritizes small and medium businesses, non-profits
Program stacking with other city and non-city grants will be encouraged and promoted.

17.description: Saskatoon City Council received the Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Advisory Committee's 2026 Work Plan for information.

18.description: Saskatoon's Environmental Advisory Committee's 2026 work plan, outlining future environmental initiatives, was presented to Council for their awareness.
